summary:
Dan is right. At 1920 and 1440, each card is 623–846px wide, but its facts only reach 31–79% of that width. Every card in a row also stretches to the tallest one, which leaves a 44–156px empty cream band above the buttons (measured on the before shots). At 844×390 the ↑↓ arrows drop onto a second row, and at 1024 Unpublish wraps.

Proposed fix, teacher-only, with ExpressionCard.tsx left untouched:
- **Grid:** the list uses the Students tab's 26rem card grid, capped at four across.
- **Cards hug their content:** rows start level and nothing stretches.
- **The Draft/Published pill and the ↑↓ arrows move into one head group.**
- **Wide cards read as a ledger:** in a card that is 27rem or more inside, the head sits level with the title at the top right, and each fact sits on one line (dab, label, value) in the usual reading order.
- **Narrow cards keep the students' stacked reading:** the pill and arrows share one strip above the title.
- **Actions:** Edit · Preview · Publish sit on one row at every width except 320px.

Measured results (list height):
- 1920: 3865 → 1983px (−49%)
- 1440: 3937 → 2785px (−29%)
- 1280: 3937 → 2885px (−27%)
- 1024: 4052 → 3879px
- 390: 8605 → 7801px

I prototyped this by injecting CSS and DOM changes into the built page. No repository files were edited, and the worktree is clean.
- After-shots: `/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-portuguese-with-ines/74999aef-5286-5911-a2fa-cdb1c96d8543/scratchpad/expressions-density/option-L3/` (`crop-list-*.png`, `notes-open-*.png`, `metrics.json`), and `option-L3-touch/` for touch sizing.
- Exact prototype CSS: `.../expressions-density/proposal-L3.css`, plus the coarse block in `proposal-L3-coarse.css`.
- Shot script and fixtures: `.../expressions-density/shoot.mjs` and `mix.json`. The fixtures are 18 seeded drafts (8 with notes, one with a 400-character note and a source link) and 2 published expressions with examples and themes.

I also tried a rejected option (`option-G/`): 3–4 narrow columns at 1440. It was only about as dense, but the titles wrapped beside the controls and the rows looked busier.

The static server I started has been stopped.
layout:
LIST (`teacher-schedule.css`, replacing ~2708 and the list line of the 740px media rule): ``` .teacher-expressions__list { --expression-gap: 1rem; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, max(26rem, (100% - 3 * var(--expression-gap)) / 4)), 1fr)); gap: var(--expression-gap); align-items: start; } ``` - Cards are 26rem minimum, as in the Students tab, and never more than four across. - `min(100%, …)` gives one column on phones, so delete `.teacher-expressions__list { grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) }` from `@media (max-width: 740px)`. Keep the filters and form rules there. - `align-items: start` makes each card hug its content. The rows still read left to right, so ↑/↓ keep meaning "earlier/later" in her order. - Do not use CSS columns or JS masonry. CSS columns scramble the order and make cards jump between columns when a notes disclosure opens. MARKUP (`ExpressionsTab.tsx` only): move the pill and the order group into one head group that comes before the card. ```
Draft|Published
↑ ↓ (unchanged buttons, labels, disabled logic)
Edit · Preview · Publish/Unpublish (unchanged)
``` - The pill stays before the card and outside the `h3`, as it is today. It stays in English and the heading's accessible name does not change. - Focus order becomes ↑ ↓ → notes → Edit → Preview → Publish, which matches the visual order: top right, then body, then foot. CARD SHELL: ``` .teacher-expression { position: relative; container: teacher-expression / inline-size; padding: 1.15rem 1.25rem 1.2rem; background/radius as now } ``` - Drop `display: flex; flex-direction: column`. - Drop the `.teacher-expression > .teacher-receipts__state` rule. - At ≤480px, padding is 1rem. CONTRACT: in `design/README.md` "Expressions in her portal", replace "Two reading columns fit a wide desktop; use one on phones." with the grid, hug and ledger rule. Amend the card bullet: in her list, a wide card sets each label beside its value in the same order, with the pill and order arrows level with the title, while a narrow card and the preview keep the students' stacked reading. Update the CSS comment above `.teacher-expressions` the same way.

perBreakpoint.layout: 4 columns × 576px wide cards (ledger). List 1682px. Today this width gives 2 columns of 1166px.

3 columns × 559px wide cards (ledger). List 3865 → 1983px, page 4899 → 3017px. Titles fit on one line except the 35-character one, which balances onto two lines in its own column. Card heights 235–390px. With a Windows scrollbar it is still 3 columns.
2 columns × 624px wide cards (ledger). List 3937 → 2785px, page 4961 → 3810px. No stretched bands; the value column is about 420px, so almost every fact fits one line.
2 columns × 551px wide cards (ledger). List 3937 → 2885px. At 1152 the cards are 492px (452px inside) and still use the ledger; long Portuguese meanings wrap to 2 lines.

2 columns × 434px narrow cards. Strip at the top: pill on the left, ↑↓ on the right. Then the title, the stacked facts as in the preview, and one action row. List 4052 → 3879px. Unpublish no longer wraps (actions row 63/110 → 40px, or 44px on touch).

1 column, 727/662/603px wide cards (ledger). Each card is 228–360px tall, so a whole card fits the 390px screen; before, cards were 410–601px tall and the arrows sat stranded on a second row. Total list height at 844 rises 4462 → 5027px (5099 with 44px touch controls). That is deliberate: one card per screen with nothing stranded, the 'phone on its side' case in the design contract. Touch sizes checked: head is 146/174px wide, buttons 44px, all on one row.

1 column × 316px narrow cards. Strip at the top: pill on the left, 44px ↑↓ on the right. Then the title and stacked facts. Edit · Preview · Publish share one row and stretch to fill it (the existing ≤480px rule); before, they took two rows with Publish and the arrows. List 8605 → 7801px.

1 column × 246px narrow cards. Same anatomy as 390. This is the only width where Publish drops to its own row, and there it spans the full width, which the contract allows for a lone action. No horizontal overflow.

cardInternals:
All of this is scoped to `.teacher-expression`; values are from the prototype.

HEAD, narrow card (default):
```
.teacher-expression__head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; margin: -.35rem -.45rem .35rem 0; }
.teacher-expression__head > .teacher-receipts__state { margin: 0 auto 0 0; }
.teacher-expression__order { display: flex; gap: .5rem; margin: 0; }
.teacher-expression__order .teacher-icon-button { width: 36px; height: 36px; }
```
- The arrows keep their existing ::after, giving a 44px tap area. With the 8px gap, neighbouring tap areas meet edge to edge.
- Under `@media (max-width: 480px), (pointer: coarse)`: arrows 44×44, gap .25rem, and `::after { inset: 0 }`. This also fixes today's overlap, where ↓'s hit area covers the edge of ↑.

ACTIONS:
```
.teacher-expression__actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: .4rem; margin-top: 1.1rem; padding-top: 0; }
.teacher-expression__actions .button { padding-inline: .8rem; letter-spacing: .1em; }
```
- No `margin-top: auto`, so there is no band above the buttons.
- The button spacing matches the try-out's foot buttons (existing rule at ~2703).
- Keep the colours (blue Edit, lilac Preview and Publish, eye icon) and the existing ≤480px `flex: 1 1 auto`.
- Remove `.teacher-expression__order { margin-left: auto }` and the ≤480px `margin-left: 0`.

WIDE CARD, `@container teacher-expression (min-width: 27rem)` (about a 477px card):
- **Head:**
  - `.teacher-expression__head { position: absolute; top: .9rem; right: .8rem; height: 2.5rem; margin: 0; }`, with the pill's margin set to 0.
  - The head is centred on the title's first line.
- **Title:**
  - `.expression-card__title { margin-bottom: .7rem; padding-right: var(--expression-head-room, 10.5rem); text-wrap: balance; }`
  - The reserved room covers the wider Published head (162px; 174px on touch).
  - Set `--expression-head-room: 11.25rem` under the coarse/≤480px query.
  - Long titles balance inside their own column ("Nascer com o rabo / virado para a Lua"). I tried a float first; it split titles badly.
- **Ledger rows:**
  - `.expression-card__meanings { gap: .55rem }`.
  - `:is(.expression-card__fact, .expression-card__examples) { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 7.75rem minmax(0,1fr); column-gap: 1rem; align-items: start; --lead: .22rem }`.
  - `[data-fact="meaning"] { --lead: .29rem }`; `.expression-card__examples { --lead: .24rem; margin-top: .55rem }`.
  - Each `--lead` is half of (value line height minus the label's .99rem line).
  - Child `.expression-card__label { padding-top: var(--lead) }`, and `::before { top: calc(.02rem + var(--lead)) }`, so dab, label and the value's first line sit level. Without this, the dabs ride above the labels.
  - `dd` and the examples `ul`: margin 0.
- **Extras:** `.expression-card__extras { margin-top: .4rem; padding-left: 10.5rem }`, which is 1.75 + 7.75 + 1rem. Themes, `Notas e origem` and the opened notes all align with the values.

Labels, dabs, colours, sizes, the paint wash on example phrases and the reading order are exactly the shared ones.
keepStudentReading:
- **No shared code changes.** `ExpressionCard.tsx`, `StudentExpressions.tsx` and the `.expression-card*` / `.expression-reading*` rules in `globals.css` stay as they are.
- **Every new rule is scoped** under `.teacher-expressions__list`, `.teacher-expression` or `@container teacher-expression`. `.teacher-expression` only wraps cards in her list.
- **The preview dialog is outside that scope.** It renders `<ExpressionCard>` directly inside `.expression-dialog--preview`, so it keeps the students' stacked reading at its 620px width. That stacked look is exactly what "Preview as students see it" should show.
- **The students' reading and her try-out are outside it too.** Both use `.expression-reading` with their own `expressions` container, and `.teacher-expression` is not an ancestor of the try-out. Nothing reaches them.
- **The QA checks stay valid.** The pill stays outside the `h3`, so headings keep their exact accessible names: `scripts/qa-flow.mjs` matches student headings exactly, and `scripts/qa-teacher-calendar.mjs` checks `.teacher-expression .expression-card` text. No guarded selector is renamed; `.teacher-receipts__state` and `.teacher-expression__order` only move into the new `.teacher-expression__head`.
- **How to verify:**
  - Re-shoot the preview dialog at 1440 and 390 and compare it with the baseline in `before/preview-dialog-1440x900.png` and `before/preview-dialog-390x844.png`; it should be pixel-identical.
  - Paint the try-out once at 1440 and 390 and compare it with main.
  - Run the existing release journeys. No new test is needed under the lean-test rule: this is layout, and no current check needs replacing.
risks:
1. **Ragged rows.** With rows starting level, a short draft beside a published card (with examples and themes) leaves up to ~150px of lilac sheet below the draft (visible at 1440/1920 in `option-L3`). I accepted this deliberately: it is sheet between cards, not an empty card, and her order stays left to right. Opening notes only grows its own row. Masonry would break the ↑/↓ order (CSS columns) or add JS layout code. If Dan still dislikes it, the next move is a product decision, not more CSS.
2. **The list now differs from the preview.** Wide list cards set each label beside its value, while the preview and the students' card stack labels above values. The design contract currently says "each under a small uppercase label" and "Two reading columns fit a wide desktop", so `design/README.md` and the CSS comment must be updated in the same commit.
3. **↑/↓ in a 2–4 column grid mean earlier/later** (left, or the end of the previous row), as they already do in today's 2-column grid. The labels stay "Move X up/down".
4. **The head-room reserve is tied to sizes.** It assumes the "Published" pill plus the arrows: 10.5rem, or 11.25rem with touch-size controls. Changing the pill text or arrow size means updating the reserve. `text-wrap: balance` is a progressive enhancement; without it, titles wrap normally.
5. **The ledger switch is near ~1110px viewport width.** It switches at 27rem inside the card. Just above it (1110–1220px), the value column is about 260–300px and long Portuguese meanings take two lines; below it, cards use the stacked anatomy.
6. **The touch variant was checked by forcing the rules.** Playwright would not flip `(pointer: coarse)` in this headless build, even with touch emulation over CDP. I verified the touch sizing by applying those rules unconditionally (`option-L3-touch`: 44px buttons and arrows, one row, head 146/174px). The implementer should check the 844×390 touch layout on a real device or with the same forced CSS.
7. **Scrollbars.** A Windows scrollbar takes about 17px of list width: 1920 stays at 3 columns, 1440 at 2, and 1024 at 2 (2×416+16 = 848 ≤ ~867).
8. **Landscape phones scroll further in total** (+13% at 844×390) in exchange for whole cards on screen and no stranded arrows.
9. **Container queries.** `container-type: inline-size` on each card is fine inside the grid (the width comes from the track) and needs browsers with container-query support, which the students' card already relies on.
10. **Out of scope.** The intro, try-out and filters are unchanged. On wide screens the search field still stretches to two-thirds of the sheet; that is a separate, optional tidy-up.
